LESSON: SLAVERY AND SERVITUDE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.3: Slavery and Servitude

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Slavery and Servitude
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why has slavery and servitude existed for thousands of years?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
2. explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example

• Model B for “explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
• Model 2: explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
2. Practise: explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Slavery and Servitude.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why has slavery and servitude existed for thousands of years?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the various forms of slavery and servitude in traditional African and contemporary society
• explain factors that led to the development of the Indian Ocean slave trade
